body.p: The following listing of claims will replace all prior versions and listings of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (currently amended) A vehicle control system comprising:
a vehicle control device configured to control traveling of an autonomous driving vehicle; and
a center device configured to communicate with the vehicle control device, wherein the center device includes at least one processor and a memory coupled to the at least one processor, configured to a termination recognition unit configured to recognize that the autonomous driving vehicle terminates autonomous driving,a first setting unit configured to (i) set, when the termination recognition unit center device processor recognizes that the autonomous driving vehicle terminates the autonomous driving, a first stop position for stopping the autonomous driving vehicle as a target vehicle based on position information transmitted from the target vehicle that indicates the autonomous driving vehicle to terminate the autonomous driving and map information previously prepared and (ii) transmit the first stop position to the target vehicle,
a passenger acquisition unit configured to acquire a type of a passenger of the target vehicle, and
a relief setting unit configured to set a relief method for the passenger according to the type of the passenger and set a dialogue method for dialogue with the passenger according to the type of the passenger,
the vehicle control device includes at least one processor and a memory coupled to the at least one processor, configured to an inappropriateness reception unit configured to receive inappropriate information indicating that the autonomous driving is inappropriate for the autonomous driving vehicle,a second setting unit configured to set a second stop position for stopping the autonomous driving vehicle as the target vehicle,
a stop acquisition unit configured to transmit at least the position information of the target vehicle to the center device and acquire the first stop position, and
a stop control unit configured to cause the target vehicle to head to the second stop position, which has been decided by the vehicle control device placed on the target vehicle, in a case where the first stop position is not acquired from the center device,and, in response to acquiring the first stop position, cause the target vehicle to head to the first stop position in a case where the first stop position is acquired from the center device,
the center device is placed outside the autonomous driving vehicle and the vehicle control device is placed to the autonomous driving vehicle, and the center device and the vehicle control device wirelessly communicate with each other,
the type of the passenger of the target vehicle includes types of a passenger classified based on a degree of assistance required for a relief to the passenger, and
the first stop position is decided by the center device and the second stop position is decided by the vehicle control device.
2. (currently amended) The vehicle control system according to claim 1, wherein the relief setting unit center device processor outputs an instruction to a relief vehicle to head to the first stop position, and
the first setting unit sets the first stop position, which is set by the center device processor, is[[ at]] a position intermediate between a present position of the relief vehicle and a present position of the target vehicle.
3. (currently amended) The vehicle control system according to claim 2, wherein the first setting unit center device processor sets the first stop position at a position temporally intermediate between a present position of the relief vehicle and a present position of the target vehicle.
4. (currently amended) The vehicle control system according to claim 1, wherein when the type of the passenger includes a person requiring care, the first setting unit center device processor sets the first stop position at a predetermined position having space necessary for care.
